note: Linkage facts ledger.json has no field for. Prefer adminDeploymentId, so the ledger stays the single place an address is maintained; adminAddress is for an administrator the ledger does not list at all, and the renderer rejects it for an address the ledger already carries. Read basis before reading a passing run: a chain-baseline expectation was seeded from the chain it is checked against, so it detects change, it does not corroborate design. Promoting one to published-design or governance-record, with a citation in note, is what turns it into an independent check.
